theorem_title: Exact uniform bound for the twelve-term normalized numerator
natural_language_statement:
For $B,x\in\mathbb N$, define the normalized twelve-term numerator $N_{12}(B,x)=\sum_{i=0}^{11}3^{11-i}D_i(B,x)$. Here $f_i=\lfloor\log_2(3^i)\rfloor$, and $D_i(B,x)$ is $2^{f_i}B$ when $3^i x<2^{f_i+1}B$, and $2^{f_i+1}B$ otherwise.

If $B>0$ and $B\le x<2B$, then

$$
262144\,N_{12}(B,x)\le416200322061\,x.
$$

This finite phase bound is the arithmetic input to twelve-step mechanical-envelope propagation.
formal_statement:
theorem CollatzWork.blockNumerator12_exact_bound {B x : Nat} (hB : 0 < B)
    (hxlo : B ≤ x) (hxhi : x < 2 * B) :
    262144 * blockNumerator12 B x ≤ 416200322061 * x := by sorry
